win.sound.mixerPageCaption: The volume of each app, where sound plays and which microphone apps use.
win.sound.noBoostNote: Each app goes up to 100%. Windows has no way to make one app louder than that without installing an audio driver.
win.sound.routingUnavailableNote: Choosing an output per app is not available on this version of Windows.
win.sound.routingRestartHint: The app may need to restart its audio to move.
win.sound.switchUnavailableNote: Windows does not allow this app to change the default device on this PC.
win.sound.switchRefused: Windows did not accept the change
win.sound.headphoneGuardJackNote: On many PCs the headphone jack and the speakers are one Windows device. Unplugging wired headphones there changes nothing Windows can see, so the volume stays as it is.
Strings.micMuteCaption: Cuts the PC’s microphone with a click or shortcut, across every app.
Strings.micMuteMenuBarToggle: Show in the system tray while muted
Strings.micMuteMenuBarCaption: A red badge appears on the app’s icon in the system tray while this feature mutes the microphone.
Strings.preciseVolumeRollerCaption: Turns the volume keys and knobs into smaller steps. Hold Ctrl, Alt or Win for Windows’ usual step. Windows’ own volume indicator stays hidden, so the app shows the level.
mixer.arrange: Hold Ctrl and drag to reorder
